newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: ASEAN can play role in Cambodia stability, PM says.
newsitem.headline: ASEAN can play role in Cambodia stability, PM says.

text.p: Cambodia's co-prime minister Hun Sen said on Thursday the Association of South East Asian Nations (ASEAN) could play a role in ensuring Cambodia's stability and said he was not upset by the group's decision to delay Cambodia's membership.
"I don't feel any upset because of that...we have to respect the decision made by ASEAN," he told reporters. Hun Sen said Cambodia could wait for membership of ASEAN.
ASEAN, which already grouped Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam, on Wednesday admitted Burma and Laos but delayed Cambodia's entry indefinitely.

Cambodian Foreign Minister Ung Huot arrived in Kuala Lumpur on Wednesday to attend ASEAN's annual foreign ministers' meeting as an observer and said Hun Sen had adopted a new position on ASEAN mediation efforts in Cambodia's political troubles.

Hun Sen, who ousted his co-premier on July 6, rejected a mediation push by an ASEAN mission on Sunday, saying foreigners should keep out of Cambodia's affairs but on Thursday Hun Sen said ASEAN's role in ensuring stability in Cambodia was needed.
